title: o9 Analyst
description:
O9 Analyst Planning Applications Overview: Position Overview: The Program will consist of COE teams across multiple Functions of Planning, like Demand Planning/Supply planning/Merchandise Financial Planning along with Assortment Planning & Space Planning. It will be a close collaboration with Data Analytics Team. This role supports the Space Planning teams digital transformation by developing functional and technical expertise in Space Planning technology. The primary focus is implementing and rolling out the o9 application and integrating it with multiple upstream and downstream systems. The selected candidate will serve as a functional and technical liaison to cross-functional partners,ensuring the application meets business needs and enables users to work efficiently and effectively. Essential Duties & Responsibilities: Understand the Strategy and Vision for multi-year journey for NGT(IBP) and work with the Product lead(s) to deliver experiences around Product transformation Capture & document business processes, functional & data requirements and be able to communicate with technical resources Develop into the technical & functional expert at RL on the O9 platform Work with Supply Planning solution owner to determine sequencing of concepts/ stories Work on enhancement requests and CRs Develop prototypes to prove the success or failure of a concept Develop/execute test scripts for Use cases Work with Support Team as per shift to help the Business in day-to-day activity to smoothly run Operations Resolve & work to find the RCA for any ongoing or new Production issues Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support users through change management, training, and issue resolution. Troubleshoot production support issues post deployment and suggest solutions as required 
 Experience, Skills & Knowledge: Minimum Qualifications: Bachelors degree in supply chain, computer science, mathematics, engineering, or a related discipline; a master’s degree is preferred. At least 3-5 years’ experience implementing o9 technology applications and working with data requirements. Experience with configuration, systemic workflows, development/enhancements, and integration of modern applications. Firsthand development experience on SaaS platforms, IBPL/Solver & o9 Model Builder. Knowledge of O9 and understanding Int3.0/SSIS flows & End to End to End o9 Configurations. Strong problem-solving, collaboration, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with team members and cross-functional partners. Good Domain/Functional knowledge in Space Planning, Demand Planning, Supply planning, MFP or Assortment Planning. Ability to effectively multi-task, prioritize and adapt in a fast-paced, dynamic business environment Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Experience working with an Agile methodology is a plus Experience with Retail industry and master data is a plus Experience working with an S&OP or Supply Planning application is a plus 
 Location : Pan India (Hybrid)

Key Skills: O9,Supply Planning,Demand Planning,Analysis,Planning,Supply
